name: Input tokens per model call
description:
Shows: Median and largest input tokens per model call (chat spans) per day, by agent and phase. The first call of a phase is the fixed prompt; later calls add every tool result kept so far.
Why it matters: Input size drives cost, latency and the risk of hitting token limits. Context trimming and on-demand context files should pull both lines down; a rising line means context is bloating again.
